turns.q: Hi! I'm looking for a gift for someone and I'm not sure what to pick, can you help?
turns.replyTail: : Absolutely! An Oh Polly e-gift card is a great option if you’re unsure of their style. 💝 You can choose £10, £25, £50 or £100, then check out as normal. The e-gift card will be emailed to you with instructions for your recipient to redeem it at checkout. You can also shop Oh Polly in store or online, with options available in the United States, United Kingdom and internationally. Please note that gift cards purchased from our sister website, Bo+Tee, cannot be redeemed on the Oh Polly website.
